highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia m151 and delivers a wave of managed-code performance improvements.
highlights_body: Hot paths across HarfBuzzSharp, SKShaper, SKColor, and SKPMColor move allocation-heavy work into managed code, reducing P/Invoke round-trips and eliminating short-lived array allocations. WASM support is extended to .NET 11 via Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries.

bullets.detail: The engine is now built from Skia chrome/m151, bringing upstream rendering fixes and improvements from Google's Chromium-aligned release.
Three additional upstream syncs from the chrome/m151 branch apply engine-level stability and correctness improvements throughout the release cycle.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimised with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: Parsing hex colour strings is now allocation-free on the fast path, and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads let callers avoid string allocations entirely.
GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe context, making it easier to use in projects that do not enable unsafe code.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was not released when decoding a cropped region from an SKData source failed, leading to a silent memory leak.
A duplicate preprocessor definition in the Skia submodule produced compiler warnings in WASM builds; the upstream redefinition is now dropped.

bullets.lead: SKColor, SKColorF, SKPMColor conversions ported to managed code
bullets.detail: Color conversion hot paths (SKColor↔SKColorF and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply) now run entirely in managed C#, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on paths called per-pixel in rendering loops.
Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free, per-call char[4] allocations in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.ToString and SKFourByteTag.Parse are eliminated, and SKShaper glyph result reads use zero-copy spans.
New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries ship with SkiaSharp, enabling WASM builds targeting .NET 11 preview.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Dropped the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition, added the Graphite visual regression test harness, and shipped Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8(string), elimination of per-call char[4] allocations in Tag parsing, and Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 engine update and initial upstream stability work.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Delivered HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper allocation-free performance improvements and upstream m151 stability syncs.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Landed the final SKColor/SKPMColor managed-port performance improvements, WASM .NET 11 Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries, and the last upstream m151 stability sync.
